en.description: Distance is useful only when it buys information and control. Find a clean observation lane, make a small number of deliberate shots, and leave before the position becomes a firing range.
en.started: Work from a real standoff distance, confirm the lane, make the necessary shots, then extract. I am checking fieldcraft and discipline, not whether you can add another ten metres to a counter.
en.success: You used distance as a tool instead of a scoreboard. The lane is mapped, the position is compromised, and you knew when to leave.

ru.description: Дистанция полезна только тогда, когда даёт информацию и контроль. Найди чистый сектор наблюдения, сделай несколько выверенных выстрелов и уйди до того, как позиция превратится в тир.
ru.started: Работай с реальной дистанции, подтверди сектор, сделай необходимые выстрелы и выйди из рейда. Я проверяю полевую дисциплину, а не способность добавлять ещё десять метров к счётчику.
ru.success: Ты использовал дистанцию как инструмент, а не как таблицу рекордов. Сектор нанесён, позиция раскрыта, и ты вовремя ушёл.

objectiveIntent: one bounded precision engagement from a proven meaningful standoff-distance band
survive/extract after the engagement so positioning and disengagement matter
avoid overlap with the frozen Precision Arsenal qualification and weapon-possession scope
rewardDoctrine: XP/RUB/standing only by default. No sniper-rifle storefront, weapon unlock, optics faucet or rare ammunition supply. Any item reward requires Economy Admiral approval.
proofGates: prove the exact SPT 4.1.3 kill-condition distance field and unit semantics before selecting a final distance band
prove survived/extraction semantics and whether the precision engagement can be required in the same operation without restart punishment
audit overlap against frozen Precision Arsenal plus vanilla, Scorpion and Artem precision/sniper objectives
Economy Admiral approves final numeric rewards and any exceptional item reward
